CREATE TABLE usuarios (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    nome TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,
    senha_hash TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE sessoes (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    usuario_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES usuarios(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    token_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    expira_em TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE ocorrencias (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    bairro TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(bairro) BETWEEN 1 AND 100),
    endereco TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(endereco) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
    descricao TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(descricao) BETWEEN 1 AND 1000),
    gravidade TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (gravidade IN ('baixa', 'media', 'alta')),
    situacao TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ativo' CHECK (situacao IN ('ativo', 'resolvido')),
    criado_em TEXT NOT NULL,
    autor_id INTEGER REFERENCES usuarios(id),
    latitude REAL CHECK(latitude BETWEEN -90 AND 90),
    longitude REAL CHECK(longitude BETWEEN -180 AND 180),
    CHECK ((latitude IS NULL AND longitude IS NULL) OR (latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL))
)
checks: (latitude IS NULL AND longitude IS NULL) OR (latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL)

def conectar(database):
    """Cada operação recebe sua conexão e confirma ou desfaz a transação."""
    conexao = sqlite3.connect(str(database), timeout=10)
    conexao.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    conexao.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
    try:
        yield conexao
        conexao.commit()
    except Exception:
        conexao.rollback()
        raise
    finally:
        conexao.close()
